"""Build report.pdf: cover page + sample financial report body, merged with pypdf."""
import zlib
from datetime import date
from pypdf import PdfReader, PdfWriter

PAGE_W, PAGE_H = 612, 792  # US Letter


def esc(s):
    out = []
    for ch in s:
        o = ord(ch)
        if ch in "()\\":
            out.append("\\" + ch)
        elif o < 32 or o > 126:
            out.append("\\%03o" % o)
        else:
            out.append(ch)
    return "".join(out)


def center_text(text, size, y, font="F1", bold=False):
    # approximate Helvetica width: ~0.5 * size per char
    width = len(text) * size * 0.5
    x = (PAGE_W - width) / 2.0
    return f"BT /{font} {size} Tf {x:.1f} {y:.1f} Td ({esc(text)}) Tj ET"


def left_text(text, size, x, y, font="F1"):
    return f"BT /{font} {size} Tf {x} {y} Td ({esc(text)}) Tj ET"


def build_pdf(pages, title):
    n = len(pages)
    catalog, pagetree = 1, 2
    page_ids = [3 + 2 * i for i in range(n)]
    content_ids = [4 + 2 * i for i in range(n)]
    font_id = 3 + 2 * n
    info_id = font_id + 1
    objs = {}
    objs[catalog] = f"<< /Type /Catalog /Pages {pagetree} 0 R >>"
    kids = " ".join(f"{pid} 0 R" for pid in page_ids)
    objs[pagetree] = f"<< /Type /Pages /Kids [{kids}] /Count {n} >>"
    for i, page in enumerate(pages):
        w, h = page["width"], page["height"]
        content = "\n".join(page["content"])
        data = zlib.compress(content.encode("latin-1"))
        objs[page_ids[i]] = (
            f"<< /Type /Page /Parent {pagetree} 0 R /MediaBox [0 0 {w} {h}] "
            f"/Resources << /Font << /F1 {font_id} 0 R /F2 {font_id + 1} 0 R >> >> "
            f"/Contents {content_ids[i]} 0 R >>"
        )
        objs[content_ids[i]] = (
            f"<< /Length {len(data)} /Filter /FlateDecode >>\nstream\n"
            + data.decode("latin-1") + "\nendstream"
        )
    objs[font_id] = "<< /Type /Font /Subtype /Type1 /BaseFont /Helvetica /Encoding /WinAnsiEncoding >>"
    objs[font_id + 1] = "<< /Type /Font /Subtype /Type1 /BaseFont /Helvetica-Bold /Encoding /WinAnsiEncoding >>"
    objs[info_id] = f"<< /Title ({esc(title)}) /Producer (PDF Skill) /CreationDate (D:{date.today():%Y%m%d}) >>"

    out = bytearray(b"%PDF-1.4\n%\xe2\xe3\xcf\xd3\n")
    offsets = {}
    for i in range(1, info_id + 1):
        offsets[i] = len(out)
        out += f"{i} 0 obj\n".encode("latin-1")
        out += objs[i].encode("latin-1")
        out += b"\nendobj\n"
    xref_pos = len(out)
    out += f"xref\n0 {info_id + 1}\n".encode("latin-1")
    out += b"0000000000 65535 f \n"
    for i in range(1, info_id + 1):
        out += f"{offsets[i]:010d} 00000 n \n".encode("latin-1")
    out += (
        f"trailer\n<< /Size {info_id + 1} /Root {catalog} 0 R /Info {info_id} 0 R >>\n"
        f"startxref\n{xref_pos}\n%%EOF\n"
    ).encode("latin-1")
    return bytes(out)


today = date.today().strftime("%B %d, %Y")

# ---------- Cover page ----------
cover_ops = []
cover_ops.append("q")
cover_ops.append("0.85 0.85 0.85 rg 0 0 612 792 re f")          # light grey background
cover_ops.append("0 0 0 RG 2 w 66 500 480 0 re S")              # horizontal rule
cover_ops.append("Q")
cover_ops.append(center_text("Annual Financial Report", 34, 560, font="F2"))
cover_ops.append(center_text(today, 20, 470))
cover_ops.append(center_text("Prepared by the Finance Department", 14, 430))
cover_ops.append(center_text("This document presents the organization's financial results", 11, 400))
cover_ops.append(center_text("for the fiscal year, including income, expenses, and assets.", 11, 384))
cover_page = {"width": PAGE_W, "height": PAGE_H, "content": cover_ops}

# ---------- Report body (sample financial content, 2 pages) ----------
body_ops1 = []
body_ops1.append(center_text("Financial Summary", 22, 740, font="F2"))
body_ops1.append(left_text("Revenue and Expenses (USD)", 14, 72, 690, font="F2"))
rows1 = [
    ("Total Revenue", "1,245,000"),
    ("Cost of Goods Sold", "412,000"),
    ("Gross Profit", "833,000"),
    ("Operating Expenses", "298,000"),
    ("Operating Income", "535,000"),
    ("Net Income", "402,000"),
]
y = 660
for label, val in rows1:
    body_ops1.append(left_text(label, 12, 90, y))
    body_ops1.append(left_text(val, 12, 480, y))
    body_ops1.append(f"0.7 0.7 0.7 RG 0.5 w 90 {y - 4} 440 0 re S")
    y -= 26
body_ops1.append(left_text("All figures are unaudited sample data for demonstration purposes.", 10, 90, 120))
body_page1 = {"width": PAGE_W, "height": PAGE_H, "content": body_ops1}

body_ops2 = []
body_ops2.append(center_text("Balance Sheet Highlights", 20, 740, font="F2"))
rows2 = [
    ("Cash and Equivalents", "680,000"),
    ("Accounts Receivable", "215,000"),
    ("Property and Equipment", "1,020,000"),
    ("Total Assets", "1,915,000"),
    ("Total Liabilities", "740,000"),
    ("Total Equity", "1,175,000"),
]
y = 690
for label, val in rows2:
    body_ops2.append(left_text(label, 12, 90, y))
    body_ops2.append(left_text(val, 12, 480, y))
    body_ops2.append(f"0.7 0.7 0.7 RG 0.5 w 90 {y - 4} 440 0 re S")
    y -= 26
body_ops2.append(left_text("Notes: Figures rounded to nearest thousand. See accompanying statements.", 10, 90, 120))
body_page2 = {"width": PAGE_W, "height": PAGE_H, "content": body_ops2}

cover_bytes = build_pdf([cover_page], "Annual Financial Report")
body_bytes = build_pdf([body_page1, body_page2], "Financial Report")

with open("cover_page.pdf", "wb") as f:
    f.write(cover_bytes)
with open("report_body.pdf", "wb") as f:
    f.write(body_bytes)

# Merge: cover first, then body -> report.pdf
writer = PdfWriter()
for src in ("cover_page.pdf", "report_body.pdf"):
    reader = PdfReader(src)
    for page in reader.pages:
        writer.add_page(page)

writer.add_metadata({
    "/Title": "Annual Financial Report",
    "/Subject": "Annual Financial Report with cover page",
    "/Producer": "PDF Skill",
    "/CreationDate": f"D:{date.today():%Y%m%d}",
})
with open("report.pdf", "wb") as f:
    writer.write(f)

print("Created cover_page.pdf, report_body.pdf, and merged report.pdf")
print("Pages in report.pdf:", len(PdfReader("report.pdf").pages))
print("Date used:", today)
PYEOF
